Test Case Description: Verify optimistic locking prevents overwriting newer profile data
PreRequisites:
- User is logged in on two different browsers/devices
- Same profile is opened on both
- Database has version/timestamp field for concurrency control
Steps to Perform: Open Manage Profile page on Browser A
Test Case Expected Result: System detects concurrent update conflict and prevents older data from overwriting newer changes. User is prompted to reload and review latest data.

Steps to Perform: Open Manage Profile page on Browser B
In Browser A: Change HoTen to 'Nguyễn Văn C' and click Lưu
In Browser B: Change HoTen to 'Nguyễn Văn D' and click Lưu

Step Expected Result:
- Browser B shows error: 'Dữ liệu đã được cập nhật bởi người khác. Vui lòng tải lại trang'
- Browser B update is rejected
- Database retains 'Nguyễn Văn C' (from Browser A)
- User is prompted to refresh and review current data
